result.instructions: Tools for Otter Waiver, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List my waivers and tell me which ones are still in draft."; "Who signed a waiver in the last few days? Show names and sign times."; "Show the latest check-ins for today's activity.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Otter Waiver data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run otterwaiver_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run otterwaiver_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run otterwaiver_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. otterwaiver_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: otterwaiver_list_waivers
tools.title: List waivers
tools.description: List the waivers of the account (title, event, status draft/active/inactive, activities, response counts). Page numbers are required by the API; the defaults are page 1 with 20 records. Filter by event name (waiver folder title) or waiver title. API: GET /waivers.

eventName.description: Filter by event name (the waiver folder title).

tools.name: otterwaiver_get_waiver
tools.title: Get waiver
tools.description: Get one waiver with its full text, settings, additional fields and signed participants. Get the id from otterwaiver_list_waivers. API: GET /waivers/{id}.

waiver_id.description: The id (UUID) from the list tool.

tools.name: otterwaiver_list_latest_participants
tools.title: List latest participants
tools.description: List the 50 most recent participants who signed a waiver: signer contact data, emergency contact, answers to extra questions, timestamps and document links. The data is personal data of the signers. API: GET /participants/latest.

tools.name: otterwaiver_list_latest_checkins
tools.title: List latest check-ins
tools.description: List the 50 most recent participant check-ins, with the same fields as otterwaiver_list_latest_participants (the checkedIn timestamp is set). API: GET /participants/latest/checkins.

tools.name: otterwaiver_get_participant
tools.title: Get participant
tools.description: Get one participant (adult or minor) by id: signer data, waiver id, timestamps, document and certificate links. Get the id from the participant lists or from a waiver. API: GET /participants/{id}.

participant_id.description: The id (UUID) from the list tool.
